messages.text: Hey Hemanth, sounds like you’re diving into the Linux setup! For Week 1, Day 6, you’ve been focusing on the file system – specifically understanding the core directories like /etc, /var, /home, /opt, and /proc. You’ve also started a GitHub repo for your cloud admin journey and created a basic README. Super ra! You’re off to a great start. How’s it going?

Okay, Hemanth. Day four – you’re deep into the Rocky Linux VM, setting up users and permissions. That’s a really solid foundation for your OpenShift journey. Don’t stress if it feels a little overwhelming at first; it’s a lot to absorb. Remember, you’re building this step-by-step. How’s it feeling so far?
